svg.title: AREA 39
svg.desc: Each broken rock raises a turret. Shoot it promptly and move the party forward as the path opens. Leave the crossed rocks by the bend intact and turn along the main route. Operate both adjacent maze switches, including the one hidden behind the first; they are left on this map and on your right when viewed from the entrance. Follow the last long room straight to the exit; its side switches are optional for supplies.
